limitations: Scalar Kalman model, common precision, independent Bernoulli packet reception, nonadaptive one-use permutations, finite terminal covariance objective; no claims for adaptive scheduling or unequal precision.
scientific_integrity: The theorem and its finite examples have been analytically reviewed and subjected to exact-rational checks. Independent validation and definitive historical priority are not established.
title: A sharp reliability-ordering law for finite-horizon Kalman sensing with packet loss
